why: Both analyses connect the Delmar/Harrow's supply cliff, decline Larchmont as offered, pause the third metro, flag churn as missing without inventing it, and name Stage 2 and Stage 3 decline risks; both also choose a per-technician rather than per-machine denominator. Analysis 2 edges ahead because its hedgehog includes the rebuilt-machine bundle, its verdict screen answers all four offsite questions with the payback doubling stated, and it lists more missing data plus a disconfirming test.
